value.rationale: The 2026 near-field Fresnel model motivates exact quadratic exponential-sum cancellations and stable finite-aperture steering bases. A complete zero-locus and classification of every four-sensor orthonormal steering basis (with an exact forbidden three-distinct-phase obstruction) is a natural discrete aperture cutoff with potentially reusable parameter rigidity. This is not claimed to solve general Hadamard classification, larger sensing arrays, or physically constrained range-angle interpolation.
